nodes.norm_label: reusable compressed, snapshot, and detailed story views

nodes.label: Story ID De-duplication
nodes.rationale: Feeds de-duplicate through story_id because the live /stories collection endpoint currently times out.

nodes.label: Derived Story Chronology
nodes.rationale: Mentions are scoped to individual articles, so the UI derives a story chronology and does not claim a server-provided story-level propagation graph or trend history.

nodes.label: Independent Espresso Analysis Rail
nodes.rationale: Espresso events and signals have no declared Beans story or article identifier, so they remain independent from Beans stories.
